title: Smoky Chickpea Tagine
description: A Chinese-inspired fusion dish with the smoky flavors of a Moroccan tagine. Easy to make and nutritious, perfect for a weeknight meal.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of nourishing oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger. Cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the smoky chickpeas, soy sauce, and Moroccan spices. Stir to combine.
Cook for 2-3 minutes, until the chickpeas are coated in the sauce.
Stir in the sesame oil and season with salt to taste.
Transfer the mixture to a serving dish and garnish with chopped green onions.
Serve warm over steamed rice or noodles.
Optional: Add diced bell peppers or carrots to the skillet with the garlic and ginger for extra flavor and nutrients.
